name: Daisy Down-Set, Expansion, and Peripheral-Class Equivalence
statement: Admitting a rooted down-set embedding, construction from $K_1$ by downward-closed peripheral expansions, and having every $\Theta$-class peripheral are equivalent.
proof: A rooted down-set representation exposes a peripheral side in each coordinate: every vertex on that side has its downward neighbor across the coordinate. Conversely, orient a peripheral side as the 1-side in every $\Theta$-class. Repeatedly crossing 1-coordinates toward their mates shows that the intrinsic coordinate labels form a down-set. The established expansion theorem identifies these rooted down-sets with the downward-closed peripheral-expansion construction.
